'''''Malva setigera''''',<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Malva setigera K.F.Schimp. & Spenn. {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:561909-1 |access-date=2024-02-09 |website=Plants of the World Online |language=en}}</ref> also known as '''''Althaea hirsuta''''',<ref>{{Cite web |title=Althaea hirsuta L. {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:558818-1 |access-date=2024-02-09 |website=Plants of the World Online |language=en}}</ref> the '''rough marsh-mallow''', '''hairy marsh-mallow''', '''hispid marsh-mallow''' or '''hairy mallow''', is a species of annual herb in the family [[Malvaceae]]. It has a self-supporting growth form and simple, broad leaves. Individuals can grow to {{convert|28|cm|in|abbr=on}}.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Althaea hirsuta L. - Encyclopedia of Life|url=https://eol.org/pages/597505|access-date=2022-02-04|website=eol.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Mifsud|first=Stephen|date=2002-08-23|title=Althaea hirsuta (Hispid Marshmallow) : MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands.|url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/MALV/Althaea_hirsuta.php|access-date=2022-02-07|website=www.maltawildplants.com|language=en-us|archive-date=2021-12-27|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211227145814/https://www.maltawildplants.com/MALV/Althaea_hirsuta.php|url-status=dead}}</ref>

== Distribution ==
The rough marsh-mallow is native to central Europe, the Mediterranean and the [[Caucasus]]. It has been introduced to the United Kingdom, the United States and Canada.<ref name=":1" />
